title: Document Type Response
description: Response emitted by POST /applications/{id}/documents/{doc_id}/type upon evaluating page 1 text against deterministic document typing rules, bounded slot priors, and evidence grounding (Guide §11.1 S5).

doc_slot.description: Assigned document slot name declared at upload

doc_type.description: Classified document type (FIRE_NOC, ACCREDITATION, EOA_LETTER, AFFIDAVIT, BUILDING_PLAN, BUILDING_COMPLETION, LAND_DOCUMENTS, FACULTY_LIST) or UNCLASSIFIED

is_classified.description: True if accepted with sufficient margin and threshold; false if UNCLASSIFIED

pipeline_stage.description: Architectural pipeline stage identifier per Guide §11.1

evidence.description: Grounding evidence items mapping keywords/patterns to page blocks and bounding boxes

candidate_scores.description: Total rule match score per candidate document type

idempotent_cached.description: True if served from database cache

simulated.description: True in demo prototype indicating synthetic data / evaluation

advisory.description: Decision-support flag; does not constitute regulatory decision
